problems.unsupported: This browser has no graphics card support (WebGPU), so the speech model can't run here. Open the factory in an up-to-date Chrome or Edge.
problems.stalled: Getting ready has been stuck for 30 seconds with nothing happening. Check the internet connection, then try again.
problems.blocked: The browser is not allowed to use the microphone. Click the icon at the left of the address bar, allow the microphone, then press Talk again.
problems.no-microphone: No microphone found. Plug one in or connect your headset, then press Talk again.
problems.microphone-busy: The microphone is in use by another program. Close it (a call, a recorder), then press Talk again.
problems.microphone-failed: The microphone opened, but its sound couldn't be read. Reload the page and press Talk again.
problems.download: The speech model couldn't be downloaded. Check the internet connection, then try again.
problems.voice-failed: The coach's voice couldn't be played, so you won't hear its answers. Check that your speakers or headphones are on, then press Talk again.
problems.not-sent: Your words couldn't be sent. Please say them again.

noVoice: There's no {{language}} voice in this browser, so the answers can't be read out. Add one in the computer's speech settings, or choose another language.
loading: Getting ready, don't talk yet: loading the {{model}} speech model… {{percent}}
downloading: Downloading the {{model}} speech model, only the first time: {{percent}} ({{loaded}} of {{total}} MB)
preparing: Getting ready, don't talk yet: loading the speech model…
quietly: A short sound is being written down quietly.
